title: Lineage retirement
description: The durable record that one lineage was closed on purpose: from which state, why, and what it carried at the time. RETIRED is terminal; nothing is reachable from it. A record, not a credential: anyone able to write the file can write a consistent one.

reason.description: Read from a file, never from argv, and normalized like a publication body (BOM stripped, line endings folded to LF, trailing newlines dropped). Mandatory: a retirement without a reason is not a record.

supersededBy.description: The lineage that replaces this one, when one does; it must exist in the same store and differ from the retired lineage. Null when the lineage is simply closed.

priorState.description: The state the lineage was in when it was retired. STALE and RETIRED are absent on purpose: neither is a state a retirement can start from.

receiptId.description: The receipt the lineage held at retirement, archived under authorizations/superseded/ and no longer spendable. Null when none was ever issued.

ticketId.description: The ticket the index named at retirement. A live one refuses the retirement, so this is either null or an already expired ticket swept at the same time.

attempts.description: How many attempts the store had issued. The attempt records themselves are untouched.
